subject: English
question_text: Fill in each gap with suitable words based on the information of the text. 1 5 =
stimulus: Nepal is a small yet culturally rich country situated between India and China. It is the only Hindu (a) ------- in the world and home to both Hindus and Buddhists living in harmony. The sacred Temple of Pashupatinath and the birthplace of Lord Buddha, Lumbini, make Nepal a holy land for followers of both (b) -------. The Kathmandu Valley is a centre of cultural heritage, with its ancient cities and magnificent monuments. Seven sites in this region have been declared (c) ------- Heritage Sites by UNESCO. Nepal’s people belong to many ethnic groups and castes, such as Chetri, Bahun, Tharu and Tamang, and nearly half of them speak (d) -------. Throughout the year, Nepal celebrates colourful festivals like Dasain and Tihar. Among the Buddhist festivals, Buddha Jayanti and Losar are significant. These festivals add to the country's vibrant (e) -------. ■■■ ■■■
guide_solution: Ans. (a) kingdom; (b) religions; (c) World; (d) Nepali; (e) culture;
